dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa — the view of Liyue from Wangshu Inn is sooo pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks that even the saddest person would feel better if they stayed here long enough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's try playing the Ancient Zither here, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knows, maybe we'll get that "sound of someone playing along" that Kazuha was talking about!
